title: Ex-CJ Panganiban asks: Can senators be impeachment judges 'in the shadows of absence?'
summary: Retired Chief Justice Artemio Panganiban offered a path for the Senate court to resolve the contentious question of what is the least number of votes to secure a conviction in the impeachment trial…

blocks.text: Retired Chief Justice Artemio Panganiban offered a path for the Senate court to resolve the contentious question of what is the least number of votes to secure a conviction in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, saying senator-judges should be guided by truth and fairness.
